title: Sampling-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.19469v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Safe exploration remains a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), limiting the deployment of RL agents in the real world. We propose Sampling-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning (SBSRL), a model-based RL algorithm that maintains safety throughout the learning process by enforcing constraints jointly across a finite set of dynamics samples. This formulation approximates an intractable worst-case optimization over uncertain dynamics and enables practical safety guarantees in continuous domains. We further introduce an exploration strategy based on constraining epistemic uncertainty, eliminating the need for explicit exploration bonuses. Under regularity conditions, we derive high-probability guarantees of safety throughout learning and a finite-time sample complexity bound for recovering a near-optimal policy. Empirically, SBSRL achieves safe and efficient exploration both in simulation and in real robotic hardware,

translated_title: 基于采样的安全强化学习
translated_abstract: 安全探索仍然是强化学习（RL）中的一个根本性挑战，它限制了RL智能体在现实世界中的部署。我们提出了基于采样的安全强化学习（SBSRL），这是一种基于模型的RL算法，通过在有限的动力学样本集合上联合实施约束，在整个学习过程中保持安全性。这一表述方式近似了针对不确定动力学的难以处理的最坏情况优化，并使连续域中的实用安全保证成为可能。我们进一步引入了一种基于约束认知不确定性的探索策略，从而无需显式的探索奖励。在正则性条件下，我们推导出了整个学习过程中安全性的高概率保证，以及恢复近最优策略的有限时间样本复杂度界。实验表明，SBSRL在仿真和真实机器人硬件上都实现了安全且高效的探索。
tldr: 该论文提出基于采样的安全强化学习算法SBSRL，通过在有限动力学样本上联合施加约束来近似最坏情况优化，并结合认知不确定性约束的探索策略，提供了学习全过程的高概率安全保证和有限时间样本复杂度界，在仿真与真实机器人上实现了安全高效的探索。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SBSRL, a model-based safe RL algorithm that approximates intractable worst-case optimization by jointly enforcing constraints over a finite set of dynamics samples, and introduces an exploration strategy constraining epistemic uncertainty, providing high-probability safety guarantees and finite-time sample complexity bounds while achieving safe and efficient exploration in both simulation and real robotic hardware.
